newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk shares barely changed in uninspired trade.
newsitem.headline: Turk shares barely changed in uninspired trade.

text.p: Istanbul shares ended barely lower on Monday as the market could not overcome fresh resistance at around the index's 1,670 level due to a lack of inspiring expectations or news, brokers said.
The IMKB National-100 .XU100 closed three points, or 0.18 percent easier at 1,651 after moving between 1,640 and 1,675.
The index had rallied 10 34 percent last week on privatisation hopes and good sentiment after the fading of political tension the previous week.
Trade volume jumped to 40.73 trillion lira from Friday's 32.93 trillion.

"The index was stuck in a narrow range despite liquidity influx which was not bad. There is no expectation left to drive the market, so activity was share-based," said Cem Baycan from Delta securities.
Brokers said the market would watch a 13-month bond auction to be held by the Treasury on Tuesday with Wednesday value to see direction of interest rates.

Of the 239 shares traded, 124 declined, 61 advanced and 54 were unchanged. The IMKB Industrial .XUSIN fell 1.27 percent to 1,638, the IMKB Services .XUHIZ lost 1.72 percent to 1,540 while the IMKB Financial .XUMAL jumped 2.25 percent to 1,772.
Actives were led by leading car maker Tofas, down 700 lira at 9,100 and T.Isbank's C series, up 5,500 lira at 48,000. They made 24 percent of the total turnover.

Dealers said trade in Tofas was boosted by expectations of a stake sale between the company's two partners -- Koc Holding and Fiat Auto. The company later said the partnership structure and relations would not change.
